_readme: WhatsApp templates for the Wellness Voucher campaign. Every template here is submitted to
Meta for approval before it can send.
submit        the body that gets submitted. Hard cap 1024 characters. Required.
longer_draft  optional fuller alternative, kept for reference only. Never submitted,
so it is allowed to be over the cap.
buttons       quick replies. Max 3, and each label max 25 characters.
build-previews.py validates all of the above on every run and refuses to write the data
file if any of it breaks - so an unsubmittable template cannot reach the approval pack.
Both caps are enforced by Meta at SUBMISSION, not at send: an over-length template is
simply rejected and the workflow step silently has nothing to send.
[Name] is the {{1}} variable and stays a placeholder: Meta counts the variable, not the
name. [voucher link] is NOT a placeholder any more. It is resolved from the links block
below before anything is counted, because Meta counts the literal characters of a static
URL in the body. Change the URL there once and every character count, every preview and
every copy-to-clipboard follows. build-previews.py fails the build on any [placeholder]

broadcast.label: Initial broadcast
broadcast.submit:
Hi, this is Tara Rose Salon.

We built something for our regulars. Not money off. A plan.

Most of us don't lack the intention. We lack a plan. A treatment here, a blowdry there, and six months on you're back where you started.

So we made three prepaid Wellness Vouchers. You place your credit, we add more on top, and we map your visits so each builds on the last.

Dip Your Toes: pay 1,000, get 1,150. Any service, 6 months.
Season of You: pay 2,500, get 3,000. Plus hair spa and glossing. 9 months.
All-In VIP Year: pay 4,500, get 5,400. Your year mapped, one major colour in. 12 months.

Tabby splits the upper two into four, and the credit stays the same.

Reception will match you with one of our selected stylists.

What each covers: [voucher link]

Three ways in: 1⃣ Reserve one for yourself. 2⃣ Tick “this is a gift” on the form and we'll send it in her name, for the woman who'd never book it herself. 3⃣ Not sure which tier? Just reply.

Closes 30 September. Shukran

Reception will match you with one of our selected stylists.

[voucher link]

Shukran.

bridge.label: Mapping-to-voucher bridge
bridge.submit: Hi [Name], your Confidence Map is with you now, and your plan is written. Most women back it with the Wellness Voucher: you place your credit, we add more on top, and the visits in your plan are already covered. It closes 30 September. Would you like me to hold a tier against your plan, or book your first visit first?

welcome_confirm_ad.label: Payment confirmation + branch choice
welcome_confirm_ad.submit:
Lovely [Name], your credit is on your account and your plan for the year has started.

One thing to set now, so we can point your priority slots and your kit at the right place: which salon should we make your home?

Tap Mamsha al Saadiyat or Khalifa City A below. Not sure which suits you? Tap Help me choose and one of us will talk it through with you, no rush.

And if you move between the two, that is fine, your credit travels with you.

expiry_touch.label: Expiry touch, 30 days left
expiry_touch.submit:
Hi [Name], this is the one message we would hate you to miss. You have 30 days left to spend the credit on your account, and we did not want the date to arrive without you hearing it from us first.

It spends on any service, up to your credit value, at the salons on your voucher. One appointment is enough to put it to use.

If the diary is tight or you are not sure what to book, reply here and we will find you something that fits, or hold a slot for you.
